    left_steps = l - pos
    # Calculate the number of steps to move the cursor to the right boundary of the range [l, r]
    right_steps = pos - r
    
    # Total steps to close tabs to the left and right of the range [l, r]
    total_steps = left_steps + right_steps
    
    return total_steps
